svg.text: P1 — PLATFORM ORCHESTRATOR, WORKFLOW & STATE CONTROL
Provide durable workflow coordination, command/event routing, version lineage, idempotency, concurrency control, sagas and callbacks while preserving domain
Numbering, naming and event linkage corrected.
Items marked FIXED changed in this edition.
Logical boundaries separable later; modular monolith now
Duplicate payment command no duplicate capture
Provider decline saga rematches fulfillment without changing
Recovered 2026-08-23 from a P1 v1.0 board dated 2026-08-19, present only
the figma folder and in neither package.
Deterministic Orchestration — same input + state = same orchestration
State is the Source of Truth
Idempotent by Design — every command safe to retry
WorkCase Scoped Ordering — strong order within WorkCase
Explicit Version Control — no stale updates, ever
Failure is Normal — retry, compensate, continue safely
Observable & Traceable — every step logged and correlated
Dead Letter Manager: failed event handling · quarantine management ·
reprocess / replay · root cause tracking · operator tooling
Audit & Trace Logger: immutable orchestration logs · step-by-step trace ·
correlation ID propagation · causal graph logging · tamper-evident
Orchestration data ownership: P1 owns orchestration metadata only —
versions, logs, lineage. Domain layers own their data. P1 guarantees
Step flow: Execute Step / Call Domain -> Success? -> yes: Record Result
Advance State -> Complete or Next Step -> End / Idle. On no: Handle
FactLedger linkage: WorkCase (01) -> Plan / Versions (02) -> Execution
Idempotent by Design, safe replay handling and **exactly-once effect
guarantee** are three statements of the same property on one board. The
chained-retry defect violates it, and scenario P1-G1 in
P1-G1 · Duplicate payment command no duplicate capture
P1-G3 · Provider decline saga rematches fulfillment without changing
Board regenerated from the corrected canonical set. Text is real SVG text — readable by script, not only by eye.
Every consumed event on this board has exactly one producer, or is declared external. Open rulings are listed in the canonical file, not decided here.
